title: The flats, 2026
logline: The flats in April 2026: the pup, eleven, walking, not running; the prints closer together; the chimney. The last spring before the month of mornings.

panels.composition: Wide mudflats at low tide with an old three-legged dog walking slowly and a man from behind a few steps back, their prints close together, the chimney across the bay.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, wide tidal mudflats at low tide with an old three-legged dog walking slowly and a man in plaid seen from behind a few steps back, their prints close together, a distant chimney across the bay, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
